Austin Retreat | Home Gym, Office & Breakfast Bar

Stay in this stylish 4-bed, 2-bath home with a private office, home gym (fan bike, weights, mats), and a large backyard for BBQs & stargazing. Enjoy a fully stocked breakfast station with a Keurig, drip coffee maker, French press, waffle maker, toaster & kettle. Cozy up by the fireplace, work remotely, or explore South Austin’s top restaurants, live music, and attractions!

Welcome to your spacious and well-equipped Austin retreat! This 4-bedroom, 2-bath home is perfect for families, remote workers, and fitness lovers.

** Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements **
- Primary Suite – A king-size bed, TV, and a dedicated office space with a desk and chair—perfect for remote work. The ensuite bathroom features a soaking tub, sleek glass shower, and double vanity.
- Guest Bedroom 1 – A queen-size bed, stylish decor, and easy access to the second bathroom.
- Guest Bedroom 2 – A queen-size bed, cozy and inviting for a restful night’s sleep.
- Children’s Room – Designed for families, featuring a crib, futon, and pack ‘n play—perfect for little ones.
We also provide a pack ‘n play, baby bather, and high chair to make your stay with little ones even easier.

** Kitchen & Dining**
- Fully stocked kitchen with everything needed to cook meals.
- Breakfast station with Keurig, drip coffee maker, French press, waffle maker, toaster, and kettle.
- Pantry stocked with all cooking prep essentials, including a KitchenAid mixer, blender, Dutch oven, and various baking mixes.
- Bright dining area perfect for family meals and conversations.

** Living Room **
- Board games for family fun and entertainment.
- Smart TV with streaming apps for movie nights.
- Comfy sofa to relax and unwind

** Home Gym & Office
- Home gym with fan bike, weights, and yoga mats.
- Dedicated office space inside the primary suite—work comfortably with an electric standing desk, chair, computer monitor, and natural light.

** Outdoor Space **
- Large backyard with a BBQ grill, lounge seating, and room for dogs to run around.
- Perfect for outdoor dining and stargazing.

Additional Amenities
- High-speed WiFi throughout the home.
- Full-size washer and dryer for convenience.
- Two-car driveway for easy parking.
Located in South Austin, just minutes from top restaurants, live music venues, shopping, and Barton Springs Pool. The perfect home base for your Austin adventure.

South Austin is a captivating blend of artistic flair, historic charm, and vibrant energy. The neighborhood pulses with a distinct personality, offering a mix of vintage shops, renowned eateries, and live music venues that epitomize the city`s soul. Known for its `Keep Austin Weird` motto, South Austin embraces creativity and individuality.

PETS
We allow up to 3 dogs of 50lb each, for $75 per pet per stay.
At the moment of booking, if you add your pets, Airbnb will include the fee for each pet in the total of your reservation.
If you’d like to bring additional pets, or larger than 50lb, please send an inquiry first for approval.
Other animals, including cats, are approved on a case by case scenario.

FIREPLACE
The fireplace is decorative and cannot be used.


GUEST RENTAL AGREEMENT, SECURITY HOLD (Which is not a security deposit and is allowable on Airbnb), & ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED

Hi! We are your welcoming hosts and we look forward to hosting you. This place is extraordinary and does require guests to complete a Guest Rental Agreement, ID verification, and Security Hold (which is not a security deposit and is allowable on Airbnb) in order to receive Arrival Instructions. Details of the Guest Rental Agreement can be found in the House Rules.


Important: When cancelling your reservation, the credit card processing fees of 3.9% + 30c will not be refunded.
If booking with a credit card that doesn`t match the guest name, you`ll be required to provide a written authorization, photo of the ID, selfie, and card showing the last 4 digits of the credit card holder, or reservation will be cancelled.
